features.method: CONUS+'s own paper (arXiv:2407.11912) states the detector sits (20.7 +/- 0.1) m from the reactor core center, 12.45 m horizontal distance from the reactor central axis, inside room ZA28R027 of the KKL containment, i.e. inside the reactor building itself. No fetched source gives the azimuth of that horizontal offset, so this point is the centre of a circle fitted to the circular part of the reactor-building outline (geometry:leibstadt-core, radius 23.0 m), taken as the reactor axis, and the detector lies within 12.45 m of it in an unknown direction. accuracy_m 30 m covers that 12.45 m offset plus the ~10 m uncertainty of the fitted axis.
features.name: CONUS+ detector position (inside the Leibstadt reactor building)

features.method: OpenStreetMap way 608881797 (building:part, roof:shape=dome, 18 vertices) kept verbatim. Identified as the reactor building because it is the only dome-roofed part of the plant and the plant's OSM power=generator node (node/257712288, BWR-1, 1220 MW) is 6 m from its centroid; no official outline or dimension of the reactor building was found, so there is no checks[] row and the shape stays 'approximate'.

provenance.locator: OSM way 608881797 (building:part, roof:shape=dome) as of 2026-10-25T11:13:24Z; node/257712288 (power=generator, BWR-1, 1220 MW) as of 2026-10-25T11:12:21Z
provenance.note: Identification by tags, not by name: this is the only dome-roofed building part in the plant and the OSM generator node of the plant (generator:type BWR-1, 1220 MW, ref 'Leibstadt') lies 6 m from its centroid inside it. Replaces the earlier proximity pick (way 567961020, a 1319 m2 building 190 m SSW of the generator node), which is not the reactor building. Dome outline: area 1719 m2, circular part radius 23.0 m (diameter 46.0 m); its west side is flattened in the OSM tracing.
